candidates.name: Orbital cellulitis
support_spans: edematous, hyperemic left eyelids
Diffuse limitation in extraocular movements in the left eye
Left-sided lacrimal sac abscess with postseptal fat stranding
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of orbital pain, edematous and hyperemic eyelids, and limitation in extraocular movements, along with imaging findings of a lacrimal sac abscess and postseptal fat stranding, are consistent with orbital cellulitis.

support_spans: several months of epiphora

candidates.why: The isolation of Streptococcus pyogenes from cultures suggests a streptococcal orbital infection, which could be contributing to the patient's symptoms and findings.

candidates.name: Orbital cellulitis complicated by optic neuritis
support_spans: Diffuse limitation in extraocular movements in the left eye

candidates.why: The combination of orbital pain, decreased visual acuity, and the findings on diffusion-weighted imaging suggesting acute injury to the optic nerve could indicate orbital cellulitis complicated by optic neuritis.
candidates.protected_reason: The presence of optic neuritis as a complication might be overlooked if the focus is primarily on the infectious aspect of the presentation.
